import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def champagne_pyramid(n, t):
    glasses = [[0.0] * (i + 1) for i in range(n)]
    glasses[0][0] = t

    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            if glasses[i][j] > 1:
                overflow = glasses[i][j] - 1
                glasses[i][j] = 1
                if i + 1 < n:
                    glasses[i + 1][j] += overflow / 2
                    glasses[i + 1][j + 1] += overflow / 2

    full_glasses = sum(1 for i in range(n) for j in range(i + 1) if glasses[i][j] >= 1)
    return full_glasses

data = input().split()
n = int(data[0])
t = int(data[1])

result = champagne_pyramid(n, t)
print(result)
